root_cause.before: Synchronous taskkill reported partial failure on Windows, including an unsupported child, but its result was ignored. The harness closed CDP first and attempted profile deletion without confirmed browser shutdown.
root_cause.observed_taskkill_error: A child could not be terminated: The operation attempted is not supported.
root_cause.correction: Use Browser.close through the existing page connection, dispose pending CDP requests, await the owned process exit, then asynchronously remove only its registered canonical profile. Bounded force termination is a fallback; failed cleanup fails the command. Primary test failures and server closure are preserved.
root_cause.no_workaround: No browser environment override, external preloader, host-side cleanup or assertion change was used in the final run.
